classes.name: ReportingEntity
classes.description: The group or company that publishes financial reports: the parent of the consolidated group. One node per group, shared by all its reports.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Short commercial name of the group as on the cover of its reports, without legal form (Lufthansa Group, easyJet)

attributes.name: legalName
attributes.description: Legal name of the parent company with its legal form (Deutsche Lufthansa AG, easyJet plc, Air France-KLM S.A.)

attributes.name: countryOfIncorporation
attributes.description: Country where the parent company is incorporated

attributes.name: headOffice
attributes.description: City of the registered or head office

attributes.name: stockExchanges
attributes.description: Stock exchanges where the shares are listed, as written

attributes.name: tickerSymbol
attributes.description: Ticker of the share (LHA, IAG, RYA, EZJ, AF)

attributes.name: lei
attributes.description: Legal Entity Identifier, 20 characters, when printed

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: Sector of activity as the group describes it

attributes.name: businessDescription
attributes.description: What the group does: activities, brands, markets, business model, as summarised in the report

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: Exactly one ReportingEntity per report: the group whose consolidated statements are presented. Its name is on the cover; the legal name, registered office and listing are in the general information or 'corporate information' note and on the last pages. Subsidiaries, joint ventures and other companies are GroupCompany, not ReportingEntity. Competitors and suppliers are not extracted.

classes.name: Auditor
classes.description: The audit firm that signs the auditor's report on the financial statements.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the audit firm as it signs the report (KPMG, PricewaterhouseCoopers, EY, Deloitte, Forvis Mazars)

attributes.name: office
attributes.description: City of the signing office

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: The firm, not the signing partner. It is named at the end of the independent auditor's report ('Independent auditor's report', 'Statutory auditors' report', 'Bestätigungsvermerk'). A French group has two statutory auditors: one entity each.

classes.name: FinancialReport
classes.description: One published report of a group for one financial period: annual report, universal registration document, half-year report. Each PDF is one FinancialReport.

attributes.name: issuer
attributes.description: Short commercial name of the group as on the cover, without legal form; the same value as ReportingEntity.name

attributes.name: reportYear
attributes.description: Four-digit year in which the financial year covered ends (2025); for a half-year report, the year followed by -H1 (2025-H1)

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title on the cover (Annual Report and Accounts 2025, Universal Registration Document 2025)

attributes.name: periodStartDate
attributes.description: First day of the financial period covered

attributes.name: periodEndDate
attributes.description: Last day of the financial period covered: the balance sheet date (31 December 2025, 31 March 2025, 30 September 2025)

attributes.name: publicationDate
attributes.description: Date of publication or of approval of the statements by the board

attributes.name: reportingCurrency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 code of the presentation currency of the consolidated statements

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document (en, fr, de)

attributes.name: isTranslation
attributes.description: True when the document says it is a translation of an original in another language

attributes.name: filingReference
attributes.description: Filing number given by the regulator, when printed (AMF filing number of a universal registration document)

relations.name: reportingEntity
relations.description: The group that publishes the report

relations.name: auditors
relations.description: The audit firms that sign the auditor's report on these statements

enumerationRelations.name: reportType
enumerationRelations.description: Kind of report

enumerationRelations.name: accountingFramework
enumerationRelations.description: Accounting standards of the consolidated statements

enumerationRelations.name: auditOpinion
enumerationRelations.description: Opinion of the auditors on the consolidated statements

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: Exactly one FinancialReport per PDF: the document being read. Title and year are on the cover; the period dates head the primary statements ('for the year ended 31 March 2025'); the accounting framework is in the basis of preparation note; the opinion is in the auditor's report. Reports of earlier years and other documents the text refers to are NOT extracted as FinancialReport.

classes.name: Segment
classes.description: A reportable segment of a group under IFRS 8: a business segment or a geographical area for which the group publishes figures.

attributes.name: issuer
attributes.description: Short commercial name of the group, the same value as on its reports

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the segment as printed in the segment note (Passenger Airlines, Network, Maintenance, Transavia, Logistics)

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: What the segment covers: activities, brands, entities

relations.name: reportingEntity
relations.description: The group the segment belongs to

enumerationRelations.name: segmentType
enumerationRelations.description: Business segment or geographical area

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: Segments are listed in the segment reporting note ('Segment information', 'Information sectorielle', 'Segmentberichterstattung') and in the business review. Use the name of the segment note, not a brand name inside it. 'Group', 'Total', 'Eliminations', 'Reconciliation' and 'Other' columns are not segments. A group with a single segment has none.

classes.name: ReportedValue
classes.description: One figure as one report states it: a measure, for a period, for the group or one segment. The same measure of the same period stated again in a later report (a comparative, possibly restated) is another ReportedValue, attached to that later report.

attributes.name: issuer
attributes.description: Short commercial name of the group that publishes the report, as on the cover, without legal form

attributes.name: reportYear
attributes.description: Four-digit year in which the financial year of the report ends, e.g. 2025

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Measure as printed, period and scope, separated by ' | ' (Revenue | 2024 | Group; Operating result | 2025 | Maintenance; Net debt | 31 Dec 2025 | Group)

attributes.name: metricAsPrinted
attributes.description: Caption of the line exactly as printed (Total revenue, Adjusted EBIT, Profit after tax)

attributes.name: period
attributes.description: Period or date of the figure as printed in the column header (2025, 2024, 31 Mar 2025, FY25)

attributes.name: periodEndDate
attributes.description: Last day of the period of the figure, or the balance sheet date for a position

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The figure (as printed, not multiplied by the scale; negative when printed in brackets or with a minus sign)

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of the amounts (EUR, GBP, USD)

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Unit of a figure that is not money (%, x, employees, passengers in thousands, ASK in millions, aircraft)

attributes.name: isComparative
attributes.description: True when the figure is for a period earlier than the one the report covers, shown for comparison

attributes.name: isRestated
attributes.description: True when the column or line is marked restated, adjusted or re-presented ('restated', 'retraité', 'angepasst')

attributes.name: restatementNote
attributes.description: Reason given for the restatement, or the note it refers to

relations.name: report
relations.description: The report that states this fact (same issuer and reportYear)

relations.name: segment
relations.description: The segment the figure is for; none for a group figure

enumerationRelations.name: standardMetric
enumerationRelations.description: The measure in a common vocabulary, so that figures of different groups can be compared

enumerationRelations.name: valueKind
enumerationRelations.description: What kind of number the figure is

enumerationRelations.name: statement
enumerationRelations.description: Where the figure is printed

enumerationRelations.name: scale
enumerationRelations.description: Scale of the amounts, read from the table header ('in EUR million', '£ million', 'in thousands')

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: Extract the headline figures, not every cell: the key figures table, the main lines and totals of the income statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement, the segment note (revenue and result per segment), net debt and its components, and the operating indicators of the business (for an airline: passengers, capacity in ASK, load factor, fleet size). One entity per figure and per period: a line with two columns (2025 and 2024) gives two entities, the second with isComparative true. Copy the amount as printed and put the scale of the table header in 'scale'; never convert, sum or compute a figure. Choose standardMetric by meaning, not by wording ('Turnover', 'Revenue from ordinary activities' and 'Traffic revenue plus other revenue' totals are REVENUE); use OTHER when nothing fits and keep the caption in metricAsPrinted. A measure the group defines itself (adjusted, underlying, before exceptional items) takes the ADJUSTED literal when there is one. Key of the entity: 'issuer' and 'reportYear' are those of the report being read and are identical on every entity extracted from it. 'issuer' is the group's short commercial name as on the cover, without legal form (Air France-KLM, Lufthansa Group, IAG, Ryanair, easyJet), always spelled the same way. 'reportYear' is the four-digit year in which the financial year of the report ends (2025), never the year of a comparative figure. They are usually printed in the page header or footer.

classes.name: Borrowing
classes.description: One borrowing of the group as one report describes it: a bond issue, a bank loan, a credit facility, a state-backed loan, an aircraft financing.

attributes.name: issuer
attributes.description: Short commercial name of the group that publishes the report, as on the cover, without legal form

attributes.name: reportYear
attributes.description: Four-digit year in which the financial year of the report ends, e.g. 2025

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Name of the borrowing as described, with amount, rate and maturity when given (EUR 500m 3.875% notes due 2029; Revolving credit facility 2023; State-guaranteed loan)

attributes.name: borrower
attributes.description: Company of the group that borrows, when stated

attributes.name: nominalAmount
attributes.description: Nominal or committed amount (as printed, not multiplied by the scale; negative when printed in brackets or with a minus sign)

attributes.name: drawnAmount
attributes.description: Amount drawn or outstanding at the balance sheet date (as printed, not multiplied by the scale; negative when printed in brackets or with a minus sign)

attributes.name: carryingAmount
attributes.description: Carrying amount in the balance sheet (as printed, not multiplied by the scale; negative when printed in brackets or with a minus sign)

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of the amounts (EUR, GBP, USD)

attributes.name: couponRatePct
attributes.description: Fixed interest or coupon rate in percent (3.875)

attributes.name: referenceRate
attributes.description: Floating rate basis and margin as written (Euribor 3M + 1.50%, SONIA + margin)

attributes.name: issueDate
attributes.description: Date of issue or signature

attributes.name: maturityDate
attributes.description: Final maturity date; the year alone when only the year is printed

attributes.name: isSecured
attributes.description: True when the borrowing is secured on assets (aircraft, slots, shares)

attributes.name: security
attributes.description: Assets pledged or guarantees given for this borrowing

attributes.name: terms
attributes.description: Other terms as described: covenants, change-of-control clause, early redemption, conversion terms, sustainability-linked step-up

relations.name: report
relations.description: The report that states this fact (same issuer and reportYear)

enumerationRelations.name: borrowingType
enumerationRelations.description: Kind of borrowing

enumerationRelations.name: interestRateType
enumerationRelations.description: Fixed or floating rate

enumerationRelations.name: scale
enumerationRelations.description: Scale of the amounts, read from the table header ('in EUR million', '£ million', 'in thousands')

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: Borrowings are described in the notes on financial debt, borrowings or interest-bearing liabilities and in the liquidity section of the management report, often as a table of bond issues (issuer, amount, coupon, maturity). One entity per instrument named on its own; totals by category ('Bonds', 'Bank loans') are ReportedValue or DebtMaturity, not Borrowing. Leases are extracted only as the total lease liability (ReportedValue), not contract by contract. Key of the entity: 'issuer' and 'reportYear' are those of the report being read and are identical on every entity extracted from it. 'issuer' is the group's short commercial name as on the cover, without legal form (Air France-KLM, Lufthansa Group, IAG, Ryanair, easyJet), always spelled the same way. 'reportYear' is the four-digit year in which the financial year of the report ends (2025), never the year of a comparative figure. They are usually printed in the page header or footer.

classes.name: Covenant
classes.description: A financial covenant or similar undertaking attached to the group's financing, with its required level and, when given, its level at the test date.

attributes.name: issuer
attributes.description: Short commercial name of the group that publishes the report, as on the cover, without legal form

attributes.name: reportYear
attributes.description: Four-digit year in which the financial year of the report ends, e.g. 2025

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The covenant and the financing it belongs to (Net debt / EBITDA - revolving credit facility; Minimum liquidity - state loan)

attributes.name: definition
attributes.description: How the covenant is defined and calculated, as written

attributes.name: facility
attributes.description: The borrowing or facility the covenant belongs to, as named

attributes.name: requiredLevel
attributes.description: Required level as printed (not above 3.5x, at least EUR 1.5 billion)

attributes.name: requiredValue
attributes.description: The number of the required level (3.5)

attributes.name: actualLevel
attributes.description: Level reached at the test date as printed

attributes.name: actualValue
attributes.description: The number of the level reached

attributes.name: testDate

attributes.name: consequence

relations.name: report

enumerationRelations.name: status
enumerationRelations.description: Whether the group states that the covenant was met

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: Covenants are in the financial debt note, the liquidity risk note and the going-concern paragraph. Extract one only when a ratio or threshold is described; a sentence saying the financing 'contains customary covenants' or 'no financial covenants' is extracted once, with that sentence as definition and no values. Key of the entity: 'issuer' and 'reportYear' are those of the report being read and are identical on every entity extracted from it. 'issuer' is the group's short commercial name as on the cover, without legal form (Air France-KLM, Lufthansa Group, IAG, Ryanair, easyJet), always spelled the same way. 'reportYear' is the four-digit year in which the financial year of the report ends (2025), never the year of a comparative figure. They are usually printed in the page header or footer.

attributes.name: issuer

attributes.name: reportYear

attributes.name: label

attributes.name: liabilityKind

attributes.name: timeBand

attributes.name: balanceDate

attributes.name: amount

attributes.name: currency

attributes.name: isUndiscounted

relations.name: report

enumerationRelations.name: scale
enumerationRelations.description: Scale of the amounts, read from the table header ('in EUR million', '£ million', 'in thousands')

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: The maturity schedule is a table of the liquidity risk note or of the financial debt note ('Maturity analysis', 'Échéancier', 'Fälligkeiten'). One entity per cell of the current year's table; the comparative table of the previous year is not extracted. Key of the entity: 'issuer' and 'reportYear' are those of the report being read and are identical on every entity extracted from it. 'issuer' is the group's short commercial name as on the cover, without legal form (Air France-KLM, Lufthansa Group, IAG, Ryanair, easyJet), always spelled the same way. 'reportYear' is the four-digit year in which the financial year of the report ends (2025), never the year of a comparative figure. They are usually printed in the page header or footer.

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: Commitments are in the notes 'Commitments', 'Contingent liabilities', 'Off-balance sheet commitments', 'Engagements hors bilan', and, for an airline, in the fleet section (order book). One entity per line of those tables or per commitment described. Key of the entity: 'issuer' and 'reportYear' are those of the report being read and are identical on every entity extracted from it. 'issuer' is the group's short commercial name as on the cover, without legal form (Air France-KLM, Lufthansa Group, IAG, Ryanair, easyJet), always spelled the same way. 'reportYear' is the four-digit year in which the financial year of the report ends (2025), never the year of a comparative figure. They are usually printed in the page header or footer.

Key of the entity: 'issuer' and 'reportYear' are those of the report being read and are identical on every entity extracted from it. 'issuer' is the group's short commercial name as on the cover, without legal form (Air France-KLM, Lufthansa Group, IAG, Ryanair, easyJet), always spelled the same way. 'reportYear' is the four-digit year in which the financial year of the report ends (2025), never the year of a comparative figure. They are usually printed in the page header or footer.

attributes.name: reportYear

stereotypePropertyInstances.valueAsString: Risks are in the chapter 'Risk factors', 'Principal risks and uncertainties', 'Facteurs de risques', 'Opportunities and risk report'. One entity per titled risk of that chapter; do not create risks from passing mentions elsewhere. Keep the title short and as printed, so that the same risk can be found again in the report of another year. Key of the entity: 'issuer' and 'reportYear' are those of the report being read and are identical on every entity extracted from it. 'issuer' is the group's short commercial name as on the cover, without legal form (Air France-KLM, Lufthansa Group, IAG, Ryanair, easyJet), always spelled the same way. 'reportYear' is the four-digit year in which the financial year of the report ends (2025), never the year of a comparative figure. They are usually printed in the page header or footer.
